readerCopy.headline: The bigger plan needs a real structure.
readerCopy.body:
An idea that sounded exciting now needs a schedule. A larger role needs a clearer division of responsibility. A financial plan needs numbers you can live with for more than one good month. You may be ready for more, but the larger version also has more maintenance attached to it.

Jupiter conjunct Saturn can make growth durable when the structure is sized to real life. Build the version you can still maintain in a bad week. Give the plan a sequence, a limit, and a place on the calendar before calling the expansion finished.
doNotAssume: Do not assume a promotion, delay, financial restriction, or that responsibility is inherently beneficial.
